summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the 4 new Canvas enhancements on DEMO-01 (/projects/154dbb84-.../canvas). All four features PASSED, plus save+reload persistence and top-right cluster regression. Feat 2 KHUNG TỪ SCENE: picker-tab-scenes shows 11 'Khung' buttons (pick-scene-frame-<code>); clicking S1 creates a new frame titled 'S1 · NỘI. QUÁN CÀ PHÊ - NGÀY' with toast 'Đã tạo khung moodboard cho S1'; second click on same scene surfaces 'Đã có khung cho scene này'. Feat 4 ẢNH BÌA: character node shows exactly 6 cover-suggestion thumbnails, one-click adds a node-media-<id> img (fetch→upload or media_url CORS fallback); setting node also shows 6 (different) suggestions and applies successfully. Feat 3 ĐỔI CỠ NODE: selecting a frame reveals resize-handle at bottom-right; dragging enlarged frame from 480x340→700x510 (Δ 220x170). Media node (add-node-media) resized 240x170→430x310. Locking the node (node-lock-btn) removes the resize-handle from DOM; unlocking restores it. Feat 1 KÉO ẢNH VÀO KHUNG: verified via addFrameImages path — with frame selected, setting a file on [data-testid=frame-file-input] added the image as a NEW frame-tile-<id>-<i> in the frame's grid (2→3 tiles) and did NOT create any loose node-media (loose count stayed 0). onDrop code inspected in Canvas.jsx L355-378: when dropFrameId is set (drop coord inside frame), it calls addFrameImages(targetFrame, files); otherwise creates loose media nodes — same code path as file input, so drop-into-frame behavior is code-verified. Persistence: after canvas-save-btn ('Đã lưu') and page reload, frame width=700 height=510 tiles=3 all persisted (backend Node model uses ConfigDict(extra='allow') to keep items/w/h/ref_id/media_url). Top-right cluster (save/fit/zoom/arrange) remains clickable while node-editor is open (previously verified iteration_5, no regression). No runtime console errors on canvas.
critical_code_review_comments: Canvas.jsx is 943 lines — approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting RegularNode/FrameNode/ResizeHandle and the picker Dialog into separate files under /pages/project/canvas/.

applyCover uses fetch(url) then upload; the CORS fallback silently persists an external media_url which relies on the remote host staying alive — consider adding a server-side proxy endpoint POST /projects/:id/canvas/media/from-url to make covers durable.
onDragLeave only clears state when e.target === wrap.current — fast pointer moves over child nodes can leave a stale drop overlay. Consider using a leave counter or checking relatedTarget.

resize.current uses el.offsetWidth as the starting size; if the node hasn't been rendered with an explicit width prior to first resize, MIN_SIZE + first drag delta is fine, but for accessibility a keyboard resize affordance would be nice.
